title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-01-02

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard capture of a fiery early‑1970 show with standout Mason’s Children, Cosmic Charlie and an epic Dark Star, though cuts and speed wavers keep it from perfect.
ai_review.review: The performances are consistently strong – the band rolls out a hot Mason's Children, a crisp Casey Jones, soulful Black Peter and a legendary Cosmic Charlie that many reviewers cite as a highlight. The recording is a soundboard source that sounds clear enough to enjoy, but suffers from occasional cuts, speed/pitch wavers and missing fragments that require patching.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical flow and several key jams, rating the show 4‑5 stars, while noting recording glitches that prevent a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear SBD with some nasty cuts, speed/pitch wavers and missing sections (e.g., parts of Cosmic Charlie, China Cat, Dark Star). A few sources sound thinner; balance/volume tweaks are recommended.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early and late shows flow with high energy; seamless segues (e.g., Cryptical → Cosmic Charlie) keep the momentum, though missing acoustic set and a few faltering moments prevent an uninterrupted arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia cuts loose especially in Dark Star and The Other One, delivering a prototype MLB‑style jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s organ shines on Cosmic Charlie, High Time and the late‑show Dark Star; Pigpen’s organ adds texture early on.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart’s percussion is highlighted as creative and powerful (Casey Jones, High Time), with tumbling drums driving several jams.
